name: theme-scope
title: Theme Scope
description: Applies a Strata theme, colour scheme and density to everything inside it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Tenant id whose tokens are loaded under [data-strata-theme]. Omit to inherit the page theme.

notes: Sets no ARIA; add dir and lang yourself for right-to-left or other-language content.

do: Put the theme, scheme and density attributes on one element — token CSS needs them together.
dont: Don't nest scopes with different schemes inside inline text; scope whole regions.
